app.title: Shoe Catalog Intelligence
app.subtitle: Attribute prediction, catalog audit and same-product retrieval on UT Zappos50K.
app.model_note: Predictions come from {run}. Confidences are calibrated probabilities, not raw model outputs.
upload.heading: Predict attributes for any shoe photo
upload.help: Upload a photo and the model predicts its attributes and finds visually similar catalog products. There is no stored record to compare against, so no audit is shown here.
catalog.heading: Audit a catalog product
catalog.help: Pick a catalog product to compare the stored attributes against the model's predictions.
predictions.heading: Predicted attributes
predictions.none: Nothing in this family passed its threshold.
audit.heading: Audit
audit.conflict_detail: The catalog says {stored}, the model predicts {predicted}.
audit.fill_detail: The catalog leaves this blank. The model predicts {predicted}.
audit.agrees_detail: The catalog and the model both say {stored}.
audit.none: No conflicts and nothing to fill.
neighbours.heading: Similar products
neighbours.help: Nearest neighbours by cosine similarity over the whole catalog, training images included. These are not a held-out result.
neighbours.caption: {brand} - {product}
footer.license: UT Zappos50K is licensed for academic, non-commercial use.
footer.retrieval: Retrieval ground truth is same-product matching, not general visual similarity. Colour is not one of the eight attribute families.
footer.seed: Runs are seed-controlled but not bitwise deterministic, and seed variance was never measured.
